title: CreepersBurnReborn
body:
This mod is an unofficial NeoForge 1.21 remake of the [Creepers Burn](https://modrinth.com/mod/creepersburn) mod, which has been open sourced on GitHub.

Creepers always bugged me, as they don't burn up, they always sneak up on me unexpected after a night.

No more of this, creepers burn like zombies and skeletons!

Though beware they take shelter like the skeletons, so expect them to be hidden in trees and other shaded places...
